messages:
sara_eng: Quick heads up — I'm scheduling the tenant_prefs JSONB add + ghost index build in tonight's 02:00 UTC release window. Deploybot will run the DDL + backfill. I want a preflight checklist and a deploybot quarantine/rollback gate added.

deploybot: Deploy queued for 2024-12-21 02:00:00 UTC (job id dbmig-171650). Holdpoints: canary (5%), read-replica-pause, post-backfill-validation. Notify: @leo_db @mike_sre @danielle_pm.

leo_db: Thanks. SQL is simple but backfill could spike read replica lag. Plan: build index concurrently on primary as ghost index then backfill with chunked updates limited to 200 rows/sec. If replica lag > 60s for 3min -> abort.

mike_sre: Add read-replica pause step — we should pause replica apply during concurrent index finalization to avoid replication lag cascades. How will Deploybot signal pause?

leo_db: Deploybot supports a pre-step hook. I added a script: ```bash
# preflight pause replica
ssh ops@db-admin 'psql -c "ALTER SYSTEM SET wal_receiver_timeout = 0;"'
# placeholder, actual pause uses replica-manager pause-replay
replica-manager pause --cluster=prod --until=02:10
```

sara_eng: Good. Also pin service-side schema version to v2-migration for the window so consumers use feature flag fallback. Danielle — can product confirm fallback is acceptable?

danielle_pm: Confirmed — client-side fallback is enabled for tenant prefs. Rollback path: feature flag on -> zero-diff. :white_check_mark:

olivia_oncall: Add an automatic rollback gate to Deploybot: if post-migration validation fails (sample keys mismatch > 0.1%) or error rate increases x3, then revert schema by restoring previous metadata and pause further deploys. Also send page.

deploybot: Acknowledged. Configuring rollback rule: 
- metric: api_errors_5m
- trigger: >3x baseline sustained 5min
- validation: sample-check script returns non-zero mismatches
- action: stop rollout, run revert-metadata job, notify #incidents + oncall.

leo_db: Validation script (will run as post-step): ```python
# sample-check.py
import psycopg2, json
# pick 1000 random tenant ids and compare old vs new default retrieval
# exit 1 on mismatches > 0.1%
```

mike_sre: Can we add a soft-quarantine in Deploybot before the global finalization? i.e. finish ghost build, run validation on 5% traffic, wait 10m, then proceed. If issues, roll back and keep the index in quarantine (not swapped into production).

sara_eng: Yes. That's the canary holdpoint I mentioned. Sequence: 
1) preflight checks + pause replicas
2) create ghost index concurrently
3) backfill chunked with rate limiter (200r/s)
4) promote 5% traffic -> validate 10m
5) on success, finalize swap; on fail, run revert path.

leo_db: I added throttling config to Deploybot: ```json
{"backfill_rate":200, "chunk_size":1000, "max_parallel_chunks":4}
```

danielle_pm: Also add a release note blurb for customers: "We're adding a tenant preferences index to improve settings lookup latency. There's a brief maintenance window; read replicas may lag temporarily." Keep wording minimal.

olivia_oncall: Paging policy: if rollback triggers, page oncall (sms + call) and auto-create incident with tag migration-db.

mike_sre: One more watch: long-lived locks. Even concurrent builds can take EXCLUSIVE locks at finalization. Add a safety timeout: if finalization takes >5m, abort and leave ghost index to be garbage-collected.

leo_db: Added finalization guard in Deploybot: abort if finalization_time > 300s. Also added explicit VACUUM FULL in cleanup path if abort occurs (to avoid bloat).

sara_eng: Great. Can someone paste the exact rollback commands for runbook? Keep them minimal.

leo_db: Rollback quick commands: ```bash
# stop rollout
deploybot stop dbmig-171650
# revert metadata version
db-meta set-schema-version prod v1
# if partial data copied, run cleanup
psql -c "DELETE FROM tenant_prefs_new WHERE migrated=true AND migrated_at > '2024-12-21'"
```

mike_sre: And oncall: to unpause replicas after any abort/success: ```bash
replica-manager resume --cluster=prod
```

deploybot: Preflight self-checks passed at 2024-12-20T23:12:00Z. Canary holdpoint configured. Abort thresholds registered.

sara_eng: Ok let's run the window. I'm adding the release note and tagging docs. I'll be available during the window. Ping me @sara_eng for any immediate decisions. :rocket: 

olivia_oncall: I'll be on standby. Oncall coverage: olivia (primary), mike_sre (backup).

danielle_pm: Noting in release notes and product changelog. Good luck.

deploybot: Final status: scheduled -> 02:00 UTC. Will post progress updates in this thread when steps start. Good luck everyone :v:
